name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: In Stormwind, the inquiry begins urgently when a diplomat fails to reach Theramore Isle. Bishop DeLavey suspects Defias foul play and sends trusted operatives to Jorgen, a discreet contact in the Valley of Heroes.

sections.title: A Vanishing in the Shadows
sections.body: A high-ranking diplomat sailed from the Eastern Kingdoms to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore Isle for sensitive talks. The diplomat never arrived. Royal investigators search Stormwind for clues. The disappearance remains secret to prevent panic and keep conspirators from learning the crown is watching.

sections.title: Private Inquiries
sections.body: Bishop DeLavey believes the Defias Brotherhood abducted the diplomat, but he does not rely only on the king’s guard. He turns to discreet contacts and seeks out Jorgen, an old acquaintance who keeps a low profile fishing in the Valley of Heroes. Jorgen is just inside the city gates.

sections.title: A Reluctant Informant
sections.body: Jorgen keeps a gruff manner and an unassuming post by the city waters, but honors old obligations to DeLavey. He warns that tracing the diplomat’s path carries deadly risks. Anyone drawn into the inquiry must keep silent.

faq.answer: The Church of the Light and the Stormwind throne guard the diplomat’s identity. They refer to them only as a key diplomat sent across the Great Sea to Theramore.

faq.q: Why was the diplomat traveling to Theramore?
faq.answer: The diplomat was sent to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore for critical talks about the security and state of the Alliance between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
Bishop DeLavey suspects the Defias Brotherhood abducted the diplomat. Their methods and accomplices in the city remain unknown.
Jorgen is an operative and longtime personal contact of Bishop DeLavey. He fishes in Stormwind’s Valley of Heroes, just inside the city gates.

faq.q: Why is the matter kept secret from the public?
faq.answer: The authorities keep the matter quiet because revealing that a vital envoy was abducted under the throne’s nose could cause chaos. It could also alert the conspirators that royal agents are hunting them.
Jorgen directs the inquiry toward Stormwind’s underworld and hidden networks to uncover where the diplomat was intercepted.

angles.text: The missing royal diplomat puts delicate negotiations between Stormwind and Lady Jaina Proudmoore’s outpost in Theramore at risk.
Bishop DeLavey uses church connections to investigate state crimes quietly when the usual royal channels may be compromised.
Jorgen is a longtime contact whose low profile helps trace missing envoys through the underground espionage beneath Stormwind’s spotless streets.
The Defias Brotherhood’s threat reaches beyond Westfall into the capital, putting the stability of the human kingdom at risk.
